frontier_selector.why: The porto-venous phase CT scan revealing compression of the left common iliac vein by the overlying right common iliac artery with a filling defect decided it.

support_spans: a porto-venous phase CT scan revealed compression of the left common iliac vein by the overlying right common iliac artery with a filling defect in the dilated, nonenhancing left common iliac vein
Doppler ultrasonography of the left lower extremity demonstrated extensive deep vein thrombosis
hemoglobin 9.5 g/dL with an MCV of 63 fL
recurrent microcytic anemia treated with iron supplementation

contradict_spans: tests for anti-beta-2-glycoprotein antibodies, lupus anticoagulant, and antiphospholipid antibodies were sent, all of which returned negative
no personal history of DVT and no family history of thromboembolic disease
